name: SVC_MCA_ACTIONS
description:
This table is used to store the command action commands related to the SVC MCA ACTION setup.

Provides a generic way to represent any execution.  An action can be considered as an "Operation on Entity", "Navigation" OR "HTTP Operation".  This entity defines the action, execution type and references to for the actual action. For example,
1.if execution type is ENTITY_OPS, it means this action would perform some operation on an entity and reference the Entity Actions to get more details about the operation.

2.if execution type is NAVIGATION, it means this action would perform some screen navigation and reference of Navigation Actions to get more details about the navigation.

3.if execution type is HTTP_OPS, it means this action indicates HTTP/JSON call to be performed and references the HTTP Actions to get more details.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: A unique identifier that is a user friendly name for the action list.

columns.name: RELATIVE_ACTION_ID
columns.description: This is the related action id represented by the primary key in one of the following tables: SVC_MCA_HTTP_ACTION, SVC_MCA_NAV_ACTION or SVC_MCA_ENTITY_ACTION

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE
columns.description:
The Type of action being performed.
Valid values can be found in the FND LOOKUPS using LOOKUP TYPE  ORA_SVC_ACTION_TYPE_CD.
Example of values are ENTITY_OPS, NAVIGATION, HTTP_OPS

columns.name: EDITABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the applicable action is part of seeded data or a custom action.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
